fields.Name: One-Time
fields.Description: Billed once and done — implementation, setup, professional services, a one-off licence. Produces no MRR/ARR and nothing to renew, which is exactly what IsRecurring = 0 tells the engine without any code reading this name.

fields.Name: Recurring
fields.Description: Billed every period for the life of the term — subscription, support, hosting. These are the lines that carry into MRR/ARR and become a renewable subscription. Rename this to Subscription if that is your house word: IsRecurring is what the engine reads, so the label is free.
